title: ClipKit Studio feature verification against supplied Word brief

sourceDocument.filename: ClipKit Studio PRD and Agent Build Brief (1).docx

implementationCommit: See the commit containing this report
summary: Audited implementation gaps repaired and rechecked; external natural-speech, Claude authentication and complete live-demo acceptance remain unverified.

statusDefinitions.PASS: The criterion’s behavior has supporting runtime/test/code evidence.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: Some behavior exists, but the complete criterion is not satisfied or fully demonstrated.
statusDefinitions.FAIL: A required capability is absent or a reproducible acceptance failure was found.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Live credentials, real speech/footage, a human listening check or client authentication is missing.

features.notes: Timeline, inspector controls, live drafts, grouping and source bounds verified.
Cut restoration, view tool and optional Whisper fallback implemented; natural-speech accuracy still external.
Native and validated folder packs, trusted TSX, discovery/watch and previews verified.
Lease renewal, real Codex edits, scopes and review mode implemented. Live Claude remains unauthenticated.
Pins/ranges, actual before/after diffs, lifecycle and targeted bundles implemented.
Persistent selection, mini inspector and explicit Ask agent implemented.
Whole-script alignment, fit options, bulk clone and preview fallback implemented. Live hybrid speech acceptance remains external.
Local grammar, recognition fallback, confidence and confirmation implemented. Physical speech accuracy/latency remain unverified.
History highlights, voice attribution and conflict-aware revision reverts implemented.
Immutable snapshot renders, alternate fit presets, quality options and used-license dialog implemented. Full spoken demo still external.

hackathonReadiness.notes: Prepared snapshot save/reset and graphics seed work. Three real Codex edits pass; full presentation rehearsals still external.
Honest separate estimates/actual usage; orphan transcript baseline bug fixed.
Local routing is fast after text exists; end-of-speech latency with Fish/microphone was not measured.
Codex works. Claude authentication/scenario and Cursor integration are missing.
Current-turn touched layers and timeline position accompany ownership/banner/activity.
Comparison control implemented for completed exports. A meaningful real-user before/after still needs the supplied talking-head clip.
Drafts, shortcuts, focus, responsive dialogs and contained thumbnails improved/tested. A comprehensive assistive-technology/contrast audit is not certified.
Implementation gaps addressed; live speech and full real-input demo acceptance are not certified.
Real proposals provide preview/ghost layers and human accept/reject with conflict-aware application.
Architecture diagram and thirty-second pitch script delivered; finished real-footage story remains dependent on user media/voice.
